verdict.rationale: Typesense's official search-application guide has a dedicated Faceting section alongside Filtering results. A community commenter independently notes that Typesense 'handle[s] faceted search already', which corroborates that faceted navigation is a supported core capability. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of live facet counts, range/numeric facets, multi-attribute facets returned from a single query, and in-depth faceting API documentation.
